# Exactly pinned, hash-verified versions of the host's core dependencies —
# the reproducible counterpart to host/requirements.txt's floating ranges.
# Used by CI, and by anyone who wants a byte-identical dependency set:
#
#     pip install --require-hashes -r host/requirements.lock.txt
#
# PySide6 (the optional tray/window GUI) is deliberately not locked here: it
# is a ~500MB install that neither the CLI, the TUI, nor the test suite
# needs. Install it separately with `pip install PySide6` if you want
# `python -m host.gui`.
#
# Regenerate after changing host/requirements.txt (needs `uv`):
#
#     grep -v '^PySide6' host/requirements.txt > /tmp/core.in
#     uv pip compile /tmp/core.in -o host/requirements.lock.txt \
#         --generate-hashes --universal --python-version 3.11
#
# then restore this header, which uv's own two-line header replaces.
